lead_responses.what_lead_said: I'm assuming that the contract... is in line with the new Renters' Rights Act?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Short letting isn't tied to the same regulations, so it doesn't really apply to what we're doing here

lead_responses.what_lead_said: The cleaning and linen section says charges will be to the guest when possible — is that something you'd arrange?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: It's automatic — the cleaning cost is bundled into the nightly price (e.g. a £100 clean included in the per-night rate), not billed separately to the owner

lead_responses.what_lead_said: On the waste management side — is bin collection the responsibility of the cleaning company or the person in the property?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Cleaners are told to put bins out ahead of the nearest collection date; if there's overflow, commercial waste collection is arranged ad hoc or monthly; the process has improved a lot recently

lead_responses.what_lead_said: The limitation of liability says the agent isn't liable for guest actions or non-compliance — what does that refer to?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: We're not liable for every guest action, but double bookings and complaints are on us; insurance and security deposits cover guest damage
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: That makes sense. That's all good, that's fine. That's literally my question, I didn't have that many, to be fair

lead_responses.what_lead_said: You mentioned in the email you changed nothing on the hospital — I think it's 20-25 minutes away by train, not close. Did that change the figures in a negative way?

lead_responses.lead_follow_up: It's pretty essential, not [an issue] — I've rented in the area before and found people working at hospitals renting nearby, so I think it should be alright. That's all been no problem for me

lead_responses.what_lead_said: I've got a call this afternoon with my new company to finalize some dates... it's really a case of tying things up on my side with relocation and then signing the contract
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: That makes complete sense — let me know what's covered on that call and we can work out a timeline; it's nice to have a few weeks' notice ahead of time so onboarding is smoother
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: Exactly. I'll definitely do that... I'll let you know as soon as I've got that date later on today
